[[File:Santo.png|thumb|250px|Santo]] '''Santo''' (Japanese: '''ソルト''' ''Salt'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY080|Performing with Fiery Charm!]]''. He is a [[Pokémon Connoisseur]] who acted as one of the judges of the [[Dendemille Town]] Rookie Class [[Pokémon Showcase]] along with [[Gena]] and [[Delilah]]. During the Theme Performance, he had his {{p|Mime Jr.}} evaluate the [[Poké Puff]]s made by the {{pkmn|Performer}}s. They let [[Miette]], [[Jessie|Jessilia]], and {{an|Serena}} advance to the second round. At the end of the Freestyle Performance, he voted along with the audience to decide the winner of the Pokémon Showcase and was shown to vote for Miette. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Santo |pkmn=Mime Jr. |type1=Psychic |type2=Fairy |img=Santo Mime Jr.png |epnum=XY080 |epname=Performing with Fiery Charm! |vaen=Kayzie Rogers |desc={{p|Mime Jr.}} is Santo's only known Pokémon. Together with [[Gena]]'s {{p|Jigglypuff}} and [[Delilah]]'s {{p|Furfrou}}, it judged the [[Poké Puff]]s made by the Performers during the Theme Performance of the {{to|Dendemille}} Rookie Class {{pkmn|Showcase}}. They let [[Miette]], [[Jessie|Jessilia]], and {{an|Serena}} advance to the Freestyle Performance. It prefers [[Flavor|spicy-flavored]] {{pkmn|food}}. None of Mime Jr.'s moves are known.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{psychic color}}|bordercolor={{fairy color light}} |ja=石塚運昇 ''[[Unshō Ishizuka]]'' |en=[[Justin Anselmi]] |fi=Ilkka Villi |it=Gianluca Iacono |pl=Krzysztof Szczepaniak |es_eu=Frank Gálvez}} ==Trivia== * Santo is the only known Pokémon Connoisseur outside of the [[Unova]] [[region]], and the only one whose class is unknown.
